title: Nanatsu no Hikan
overview:
Naoki Prize-winning author Kageki Shimoda takes on a game for the first time! High-quality 3DCG and gripping narration by famous voice actors... A shocking adventure where mystery breeds mystery, set in seven mansions standing on a cape.

7 times more fun than adventures until now! Koei's first 3-disc set.

直木賞作家・志茂田景樹、ゲームに初挑戦！
クオリティの高い3DCG、有名声優による迫真の語り…
岬に建つ七つの館を舞台に展開する謎が謎を呼ぶ衝撃のアドベンチャー。

今までのアドベンチャーより7倍おもしろい！
光栄 初の3枚組
